en: The postcard features a reproduction of the front page of the historic Portuguese newspaper 'O Seculo,' dated April 27, 1903. The layout is dominated by the newspaper's title and filled with small dense text in Portuguese. Superimposed on the left side is a black-and-white portrait of a bearded man wearing a classic early 20th-century suit. At the bottom right, there is a detailed illustration of a steamship, and near the right-center, a building is depicted. The overall style is sepia-toned and vintage, reminiscent of early 20th-century press prints.
